description: Google's latest text embedding model offering state-of-the-art performance for retrieval and semantic similarity tasks. Supports configurable output dimensions and task-type hints for optimized embeddings.

trainingData.description: Trained on diverse text data for general-purpose embeddings. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Contrastive learning techniques for embedding optimization. Specific methodology is proprietary.

evaluation.performanceSummary: State-of-the-art retrieval performance. Significant improvement over embedding-001 on MTEB benchmarks.

knownLimitations: May not capture domain-specific nuances without fine-tuning

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Embeddings may encode biases present in training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Input content filtering applied per Google's usage policies.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Data sent to API processed per Google Cloud terms.

pricing.usage: Free tier available, paid usage at low cost per 1M tokens

access.license: Proprietary - Google Cloud Terms of Service

requirements.deployment: API-only (cloud-hosted by Google), also available via Vertex AI
